summary.headline: Big caps are one oil fund and a few meme tickers
summary.dek: The cap is concentrated: one fund, American Oil Dividend Fund, holds most of the field's value, so the rest of the list is small. Below the top few, the runners are mostly pump.fun meme tickers with X accounts, many riding Anakin, Anthropic, GTA and Mamesuke names.

themes.name: Politics and oil-fund tokens
themes.take: The top coin, American Oil Dividend Fund, is a politics-tagged token with no socials and a pump.fun launch. It holds most of the field's cap by itself, so it sets the theme share more than any narrative does.

themes.name: Star Wars and Anakin names
themes.take: Anakin Coin and Anakin Skywalker sit in the top ten by cap, and Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker share the franchise theme. Several are pump.fun launches with X accounts.

themes.name: Mamesuke and Japanese Shiba names
themes.take: MAMESUKE, Mamesuke Stonk, むーちゃん and Marutaro all lean on Japanese or Shiba-inu imagery. Several launched within the last few hours of the window.

themes.name: GTA and game-death memes
themes.take: GTA VI and WASTED both reference GTA. Both are in the top 15 by cap, and both list X accounts with a website.

themes.name: Anthropic and headline ants
themes.take: Anthropic ($ANTS) plays on the Anthropic IPO headline. It is one of the few runners that ties to a named headline, and the link is in its own description.

working: Pump.fun is the main launchpad in this set: 25 of 35 runners, and the most common launch route among the top 10 by cap.
Most runners (86%) have an X account, so social presence is the norm rather than the exception.
Several of the sharpest 24h gainers are very new, under 12 hours old, such as MAMESUKE, Ahsoka Tano and Marutaro, which points to fast attention on fresh launches.
Runners that name a famous franchise or public figure in the ticker, like GTA6, Anakin and Ansem, make up a large part of the list.
fading: Uni dropped sharply in 24h after a pump.fun launch with no socials, and jeff and paws at you also fell by about half.
Baby Pump is one of the weaker names: 24h down heavily, with a top-10 holder share of 73%, far above the 25% median.
The Black Bear and Leverhedge are down over the last day, with The Black Bear also down sharply in the last hour.
Anthropic ($ANTS) is down in the last hour even though it had a gain in 24h.
summary.watch: Watch whether the new Mamesuke and Ahsoka-style launches hold their gains past the first day, since most of the 24h movers in this set are under 5 days old.
